summary: Master the art of technical writing with our comprehensive training course. Develop essential skills to produce effective documentation for any audience.
lede: Technical writing turns specialist knowledge into accurate, usable guidance for technology, engineering, operations, product, and knowledge-management teams. This course is for people who create, review, or approve documentation, helping them plan audience-focused content, structure verifiable requirements, and write clear procedures in formats such as Markdown and Word. It also covers terminology control, document versioning concepts, and review of AI-assisted drafts for accuracy and source traceability.
audienceIntro: This technical writing training suits professionals who create, review, or approve documentation in technology, engineering, operations, product, and knowledge-management environments. It supports foundation-level learners who write technical content occasionally and intermediate practitioners who want a more consistent editorial and documentation workflow.
prerequisites: No formal technical writing qualification or programming background is required. You should have basic workplace writing experience and access to a technical process, product, service, or system that you can use for practice. Coding is not required for completion. You will use sample source material and may bring a sanitized workplace example without confidential information. Advanced topics such as DITA XML, Git-based publishing, and AI-assisted documentation receive conceptual or operational coverage rather than production engineering depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
